databases.name: Database
databases.description: Data to compute the summary statistics for

arguments.name: variables_to_describe
arguments.description: A dictionary of variables to describe, where each specifies datatype ("numerical" or "categorical") and optionally inliers. For example: {"ncit:C156420": {"datatype": "numerical", "inliers": (20, 30)}} or {"ncit:C28421": {"datatype": "categorical", "inliers": ("ncit:C16576", "ncit:C20197", "ncit:C45908")}}

arguments.name: variables_to_stratify
arguments.description: Dictionary of variables to stratify on. For each variable, provide a list of allowed categories or a range with optional "start" and/or "end" values. For example: {"C28421": ["ncit:C16576"], "C156420": {"start": 30, "end": 35}}

arguments.name: organisations_to_include
arguments.description: List of organisation IDs to include. Defaults to None, which will include all organisations.

ui_visualizations.name: Categorical descriptives
ui_visualizations.description: A table providing the aggregate descriptive statistics for categorical data.

ui_visualizations.name: Numerical descriptives
ui_visualizations.description: A table providing the aggregate descriptive statistics for numerical data.

name: Descriptive Statistics
description: Algorithm to retrieve descriptive statistics. For categorical data this include value, outlier, and missing values counts. For numerical data this includes counts (total number of values), missing value counts, outlier counts, deviation sum, sum, mean, and deviation.
